title: Contents Packout & Storage Closing Payment Amount
content:
Billing office clause for the closing payment the customer makes on an insurance-funded Contents Packout & Storage job of Partial Contents Packout, Full Contents Packout, High-Value Contents Packout or Commercial Contents and Records Recovery.

**1. Standard closing payment.** The standard closing payment is the storage and declared-value coverage lines on the job billed to customer, plus the card surcharge and late fee lines on the job, less the customer payments posted to the job net of the refunds returned from them, less the billing error and duplicate line adjustment credits on the job, rounded to the cent, half up, and never below zero.

**2. Amount paid.** The closing payment amount is found by adding to the standard closing payment, before its rounding and before its floor at zero, every amount the closing payment carries, taking away every amount netted, and rounding that total once to the cent, half up, never below zero.

**3. Rounding.** Half up is applied with a tolerance of one billionth of a dollar (1e-09) added before rounding, so that a figure lying on a half cent always rounds up.

## Terms used

| Term | Meaning on the job's ledger |
|---|---|
| lines billed to customer | storage and declared-value coverage lines whose bill-to is the customer |
| card surcharge and late fee lines | every credit card surcharge line and every late fee line on the job |
| customer payments, net | customer payments posted to the job less the refunds returned from them |
| corrections | adjustment credits on the job with reason billing error or duplicate line |

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

| Customer-billed lines | Surcharge and late fee lines | Net payments | Billing error and duplicate line credits | Standard closing payment |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 880.00 | 41.20 | 500.00 | 60.00 | 361.20 |
| 300.00 | 0.00 | 350.00 | 0.00 | negative; never below zero, 0.00 |
